fields.summary: Reconnection of power supply - DRAFT status - Dissappearing PODs

content.text: I think the disappearing PODs belong to customers who currently have unpaid overdue liabilities, but these liabilities are not included in the request for disconnection connected to the disconnection. For example, UICs 202421263 and 4508272248.
They should be visible in the DRAFT listing.
